author: Eternalll
name: Brutus
short: Warn, mute, kick and ban from a message's Apps menu.
description: Right click (or long press) a message > Apps > Warn / Mute / Kick / Ban opens a form with the author's ID, a preset reason and optional details. The action runs like Red's own command: same DM (if turned on in Mod, Mutes or Warnings), same modlog case, and the message is deleted afterwards. Requires the Mod, Mutes and Warnings cogs for their respective actions.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not persistently store data or metadata about users. Warnings, mutes and modlog cases it creates are stored by Red's Warnings and Mutes cogs and Red's modlog.
install_msg: Thanks for installing Brutus. Load it, then run `[p]slash enablecog brutus` and `[p]slash sync` to add Warn, Mute, Kick and Ban to the Apps menu of messages. Set preset reasons with `[p]brutusset reasons`, and see everything with `[p]brutusset show`.
